subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should implicit Groq TPM over-reservation be handled by this Groq-owned matched retry, or by changing implicit output reservations across the shared OpenAI-compatible transport?
rationale: Both approaches fix the same user failure but define materially different provider ownership, plugin API, and cross-provider compatibility contracts; tests cannot choose that permanent architecture.

options.title: Approve Groq-scoped recovery
options.body: Land this narrowly matched provider fallback and its generic provenance field, then close the competing transport PR to keep successful requests and other providers unchanged.

options.title: Prefer shared transport semantics
options.body: Use the competing transport-level change only if maintainers intend to stop sending discovered model output ceilings as implicit reservations across OpenAI-compatible providers.

options.title: Request a narrower core seam
options.body: Pause both PRs and design a generic explicit-versus-discovered budget signal that avoids committing to either retry policy until provider owners adopt it.

recommendation.title: Approve Groq-scoped recovery
recommendation.body: Land this narrowly matched provider fallback and its generic provenance field, then close the competing transport PR to keep successful requests and other providers unchanged.
